## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] I tested or otherwise validated the change.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, tokens, cookies, or private source code.

## Provider / policy impact

If this touches an AI provider, CLI, MCP host, permissions model, or account behavior:

- link the official documentation used;
- explain any terms/policy implications;
- describe how provider safety controls are preserved.

## Security impact

Describe changes involving shell execution, filesystem access, networking, environment variables, secrets, long-running processes, skills, tools, or MCP boundaries.

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know before merging.
